content:
Install with npm ci.
Build with pnpm build, then stop.
Lint with yarn lint; then stop.
Type-check with npx tsc: done.
Start with bun run dev! Then stop.
Did you run pytest -q? Then stop.
Sync (uv sync) first.
Install with poetry install
Test with cargo test.
Compose with docker compose up, then stop.
Run python -m app; then stop.
note: Each of the eleven prose runners gives a plain-text command ending at one of the boundaries `.`, `,`, `;`, `:`, `!`, `?`, `)` or the end of the line, with the boundary removed and the leading `(` before `uv` ignored.
